cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/classic
TOK=$(grep GITHUB_TOKEN /etc/vps-github-bridge/token | cut -d= -f2)
cp classic_pos_html.py backup_both_pos_html.py; cp runs.json backup_runs_before_restart.json
f=classic_pos_html.py
curl -sf -H "Authorization: token $TOK" -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" "https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/bot/classic/$f" -o /tmp/new_$f || { echo FETCH_FAIL; exit 1; }
python3 -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/tmp/new_$f',encoding='utf-8').read())" || { echo PARSE_FAIL; exit 1; }
cp /tmp/new_$f $f; chown tbot:tbot $f
systemctl restart classicbot
for i in $(seq 1 30); do sleep 5; L=$(curl -s -m 10 localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print('1' if d.get('loading') else '0')" 2>/dev/null); [ "$L" = "0" ] && break; done
echo loading=$L
cmp runs.json backup_runs_before_restart.json && echo runs_unchanged
curl -s localhost:8091/ | grep -c "const FIN="
curl -s localhost:8091/api/runs | python3 -c "
import sys,json
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
print({k:(d['accounts'][k]['account']['equity'],d['accounts'][k]['account']['taken']) for k in ('me','bot','both')})"
